subject: [PATCH v5 01/11] mm, swap: add virtual swap device infrastructure

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch introduces the virtual swap device infrastructure, which allows for dynamic allocation of swap clusters and enables the creation of a virtual swap device that can be used by vswap. The device is capped at approximately 8 TiB in size and uses a 64-bit architecture. The patch also includes changes to various kernel files to support the new infrastructure and adds a kernel parameter 'vswap' to control the behavior of the virtual swap device. The dynamic-cluster allocator is wired in, but no allocation path can select it yet, as this will be handled in subsequent patches.
